milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan concrete pillar is at spawn-relative coordinates (5.5, 0.5, 5.5) — the center of the 2x2x2 pillar. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall with a pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe which is sufficient to mine cobblestone walls. This directly confirms the player has mined at least one wall block.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_door (from 6 iron ingots in a 2x3 pattern at the crafting table) places the resulting iron_door items into the player's inventory. The iron ingots are obtained from chests behind the cobblestone wall. The recipe yields 3 iron doors, so checking for min_count=1 is sufficient.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce_button (from 1 spruce plank at the crafting table) places the resulting spruce_button into the player's inventory. The spruce planks are obtained from the chest adjacent to the cyan concrete pillar. The recipe yields 1 button per plank.
